units.source_text: 镜中的男人，只有望着姑娘胸脯的时候，脸上才显得安详而平静。

en.t: The man in the mirror looked peaceful and calm only when he was gazing at the girl's breast.

units.source_text: 瘦弱的身体，尽管很衰弱，却带着一种安乐的和谐气氛。

en.t: His thin body, though very frail, carried a kind of easy, harmonious air.

units.source_text: 男人把围巾枕在头下，绕过鼻子，严严实实地盖住了嘴巴，然后再往上包住脸颊。

en.t: The man laid the scarf under his head, drew it around his nose, covered his mouth tightly, and then wrapped it up over his cheeks.

units.source_text: 这像是一种保护脸部的方法。

en.t: It seemed like a way of protecting his face.

units.source_text: 但围巾有时会松落下来，有时又会盖住鼻子。

en.t: But the scarf would sometimes loosen and slip down, and sometimes cover his nose.

units.source_text: 就在男人眼睛要动而未动的瞬间，姑娘就用温柔的动作，把围巾重新围好。

en.t: At the very moment before the man's eyes could move, the girl would gently set the scarf back in place.

units.source_text: 两人天真地重复着同样的动作，使岛村看着都有些焦灼。

en.t: The two of them innocently repeated the same gesture until even Shimamura, watching them, began to feel impatient.

units.source_text: 另外，裹着男人双脚的外套下摆，不时松开耷拉下来。

en.t: Also, the hem of the coat wrapped around the man's feet would come loose now and then and hang down.

units.source_text: 姑娘也马上发现了这一点，给他重新裹好。

en.t: The girl noticed that at once too, and wrapped it around him again.

units.source_text: 这一切都显得非常自然。

en.t: All of this seemed completely natural.

units.source_text: 那种姿态几乎使人认为他俩就这样忘记了所谓距离，走向了漫无边际的远方。

en.t: Their posture almost made one think that, forgetting all sense of distance, they were moving on toward an endless faraway place.

units.source_text: 正因为这样，岛村看见这种悲愁，没有觉得辛酸，就像是在梦中看见了幻影一样。

en.t: For that very reason, Shimamura did not feel pain when he saw this sorrow; it was as if he were seeing a vision in a dream.

units.source_text: 大概这些都是在虚幻的镜中幻化出来的缘故。

en.t: Perhaps it was because all of this had been transformed into an illusion inside the unreal mirror.
